 TOOS , Iiraan oo wacad ku martay in aysan ogolaan doonin in kiimikada Nukliyeerka laga qaado gudaha dalkeeda. 
 Mohsen Rezaei, oo ah xoghayaha Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa kulan uu la yeeshay Asim Munir, taliyaha guud ee ciidamada qalabka sida ee Pakistan, ku sheegay: “Xitaa hal qurub oo ka mid ah walxaha nukliyeerka ee la kobciyay laga bixin doonin Iraan”.

 2 Daqiiqadood ka hor Dowladda Ciraaq oo qaaday tallaabo culus oo ka dhana Xuutiyiinta Yemen 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Ciraaq Cali al-Zaidi Warar ayaa sheegaya in dowladda Ciraaq ay xayiraado ku soo
rogtay wakiillada Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee ku sugan magaalada Baqdaad, iyadoo ka
mamnuucday inay dhulkeeda ka fuliyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo
warbaahineed.
 Sida ay wararku tilmaamayaan, awaamiirtan waxay khuseeyaan
xubno ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta oo Ciraaq ku sugnaa tan iyo sannadkii 2018, kuwaas
oo qayb ka ah urur lagu magacaabo “Xafiiska Wakiillada Ansarullah”.
 Waaxda BBC Monitoring ayaa soo xigatay wargeyska internet-ka
ee Al-Arabi Al-Jadeed, oo xaruntiisu tahay London, balse laga leeyahay dalka
Qatar, kaas oo sheegay in sarkaal Ciraaqi ah uu sheegay in tallaabooyinkan ay
mamnuucayaan xubnaha dhaqdhaqaaqa Xuutiyiinta ee ay taageero Iiraan, kuwaas oo
ku nool Ciraaq, inay qabtaan kulammo, shirar jaraa'id ama ay fuliyaan
dhaqdhaqaaqyo ka baxsan xeerarka iyo shuruucda deggenaanshaha ee Ciraaq.
 Sarkaalku wuxuu sharaxay in dowladda Ciraaq ay u cayintay
wakiillada kooxda goobo gaar ah oo ay degganaadaan, isla markaana ay ku amartay
inay hore ugu wargeliyaan qorshayaashooda ka hor inta aysan safar gelin.
 Horaantii toddobaadkan, qaraar ka soo baxay shir ay
wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka ku yeesheen Baqdaad
ayaa ugu baaqay dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururka inay ka fogaadaan fududeynta
safarka wakiilka Xuutiyiinta ee ku sugan Tehran, isla markaana ay “ku
wareejiyaan dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Yemen haddii uu ku sugan yahay dhulkooda”.
 18 Daqiiqadood ka hor Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo war ka soo saaray weerar Sacuudigu ku eedeeyey 
 Afhayeen u hadlay fallaagada Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay
in kooxdaasi aysan Arbacadii wax diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn u dirin Madiina
ee dalka Sacuudiga, isla markaana aysan wax hawlgallo militari ah ka fulin
dalkaas.
 Hadalkan waxaa jeediyay Yahya Saree, afhayeenka milatariga
Xuutiyiinta, kaddib markii isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo uu horay u
shaaciyay inuu dhexda ugalay oo uu qabtay shan diyaaradood oo aan duuliye
lahayn, kuwaas oo ku wajahnaa Sacuudiga.
 Gobolka Madiina ayaa lagu sheegay inuu ka mid ahaa goobihii
la beegsaday weerarradan.
 “Afarta diyaaradood ee aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ku wajahnaa
Boqortooyada Sacuudiga waa la dhex galay, waana la burburiyay,” ayuu Turki
al-Maliki, afhayeenka isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo, ku qoray farriin uu
ku baahiyay barta X.
 Farriin labaad oo uu soo saaray ayuu ku sheegay in
diyaaradahaas lagu dhexda lagu qabtay gobolka bari ee Sacuudiga iyo gobolka Madiina.
 Isagoo aan sheegin cidda ka dambaysay
weerarrada, ayuu al-Maliki markii dambe shaaciyay in diyaarad kale oo aan
duuliye lahayn lagu soo dhexgalay bariga Sacuudiga
 Saacad ka hor Itoobiya oo soo xushay saddex goobood oo laga dhisayo xarumaha tamarta nukliyeerka 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Office of the Prime Minister 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Abiy iyo xubnaha ku weheliya booqashada Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed, ayaa sheegay in la baaray in ka badan 30 goobood oo loo qorsheeyay in laga dhiso xarumaha tamarta nukliyeerka, balse ugu dambayn la soo xulay saddex goobood.
 Abiy ayaa hadalkan sheegay Arbacadii, intii uu booqashada ku joogay xarunta Guddiga Tamarta Nukliyeerka ee dalkaas.
 Waxa uu sheegay in Itoobiya ay hadda heer wanaagsan ka gaartay dhismaha hay’adaha iyo qaab-dhismeedka looga baahan yahay horumarinta tiknoolajiyadda nukliyeerka.
 Sida uu sheegay, waxaa la sameeyay koox cilmi-baaris ah, shirkadna si sharci ah ayaa loo aasaasay. Waxaa sidoo kale la magacaabay shaqaalaha iyo maamulayaasha, iyadoo la dhammaystiray qaab-dhismeedka xafiisyada iyo maamulka shaqaalaha.
 Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu sheegay in goobihii hore loo aqoonsaday ay markii dambe ka yaraadeen 30, loona soo koobay 13, ka dibna shan, ugu dambayna laga soo xulay saddex goobood.
 Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in Itoobiya aysan keligeed go’aamin karin in goobahaasi ku habboon yihiin dhismaha xarumaha tamarta nukliyeerka.
 “Ma xaqiijin karno in goobahan ay yihiin kuwa ku habboon. Waa in shirkado shisheeye ay qiimeeyaan goobaha la soo xulay, ayna xaqiijiyaan ku habboonaantooda,” ayuu yiri Abiy.
 Waxa uu intaas ku daray in marka la xaqiijiyo ku habboonaanta goobta la doortay, ay lagama maarmaan noqon doonto in goobta loo diyaariyo mashruuca, isla markaana heshiis lala saxiixdo shirkad bixisa tiknoolajiyadda nukliyeerka.
 Abiy ayaa sheegay in mashaariicda tamarta nukliyeerka, sida Biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya ee GERD, aan lagu dhammaystiri karin waqti gaaban ama heshiis keliya oo shirkad lala galo.
 “Waxay ku lug leedahay hay’ado badan oo xirfadeed iyo kuwo tacliimeed, iyo qaybo kala duwan. Waa mashruuc muddo dheer qaadanaya, una baahan shaqaale badan iyo diyaargarow ballaaran,” ayuu yiri.
 Farriin uu ku baahiyay baraha bulshada ayuu ku sheegay in hay’adda tamarta nukliyeerku ay door istaraatiiji ah oo muhiim ah ku leedahay hiigsiga horumarineed ee Itoobiya muddada dheer.
 Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer lagu tilmaami jiray dal leh khayraad dabiici ah oo aad u badan. Abiy ayaa sheegay in marxaladda cusub ay tahay sidii khayraadkaas loogu beddeli lahaa horumar la taaban karo, koboc tiknoolajiyadeed iyo barwaaqo ay bulshadu wadaagto.
 Itoobiya ayaa 4-tii May bilowday qorshaha dhismaha xarun tamarta nukliyeerka laga dhaliyo. 
 Markii uu daahfurayay mashruuca, Abiy wuxuu sheegay in tamarta nukliyeerka loo adeegsan doono ujeeddooyin nabadeed oo keliya.

 2 Saacadood ka hor Xuutiyiinta oo weeraray xarun tababar oo ay leeyihiin ciidamada dowladda Yemen, kuna dilay askar badan 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters 
 Qoraalka sawirka, sawirada laga soo qaaday goobta Ugu yaraan 73 qof ayaa lagu dilay weerar ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen xarun tababar oo ay ciidamada dowladda Yemen ku lahaayeen gobolka Shabwa, sida ay warbaahinta maxalliga ahi sheegtay.
 Mas’uuliyiinta deegaanka ayaa sheegay in saddex gantaal oo kuwa riddada dheer ah lagu dhuftay xarunta tababarka.
 Weerarka ayaa dhacay Axaddii, waxaana tan iyo xilligaas sii kordhay tirada dadka ku dhintay.
 Wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ayaa xaqiijisay muuqaallo muujinaya askar dhaawac ah iyo meydad dhulka daadsan.
 Guddoomiyaha gobolka Shabwa, Cawad Al-Wazir, ayaa sheegay in in ka badan 200 oo qof ay ku dhaawacmeen weerarka.
 Afhayeenka Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa sheegay in xarunta tababarka ay weerareen ciidamada Sacuudiga.
 Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ayaan markiiba ka jawaabin codsi faallo looga dalbaday.

 2 Saacadood ka hor Madadaalo iyo goolal badan: Champions League oo dhigay rikoor cusub 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Foden oo saddex gool dhaliyay, Manchester City-na 5-1 ku garaacday AEK Athens Tan iyo markii bilowgii xilli ciyaareedkii 2024-2025 la hirgeliyay qaabka cusub ee tartanka Champions League, waxaa tartanka ka dhacay waxyaabo badan oo ay taageerayaashu xiiseeyaan. 
 Hase yeeshee, waxa sida gaarka ah u muuqda xilli ciyaareedkan waa kororka weyn ee goolasha la dhalinayo.
 Ilaa hadda, waxaa tartanka laga dhaliyay 187 gool, taas oo celcelis ahaan u dhiganta 4.16 gool kulan kasta. Waa celceliskii ugu sarreeyay ee abid laga diiwaangeliyo taariikhda Champions League.
 “Marka aad eegto tirada goolasha ay dhalinayaan, waa wax lala yaabo,” ayuu yiri Ashley Young, oo hore ugu ciyaari jiray Manchester United iyo xulka England, u sheegay BBC Radio 5 Live.
 Waxa uu intaas ku daray in weeraryahannadu ay si weyn diiradda u saarayaan fursadaha gool dhalinta.
 Stephen Warnock, oo hore ugu ciyaari jiray difaaca Liverpool, ayaa isaguna tirada goolasha ku tilmaamay mid aan caadi ahayn. Hase yeeshee, su’aashu waxay tahay: arrintani ma wax ku kooban xilli ciyaareedkan oo keliya ayay tahay?
 Maxay tirakoobyadu muujinayaan? 
 Celceliska hadda ah ee 4.16 gool kulan kasta ma aha oo keliya rikoor cusub oo Champions League ah, balse sidoo kale waa celceliskii saddexaad ee ugu sarreeyay taariikhda tartanka Yurub ee European Cup.
 Kaliya laba xilli ciyaareed ayaa laga diiwaangeliyay celcelis ka sarreeya: xilli ciyaareedkii 1955-1956, oo celceliskiisu ahaa 4.38 gool kulan kasta, iyo kii 1959-1960, oo ahaa 4.19 gool.
 Goolasha ayaa weli ku socda xawaare aad u sarreeya. Talaadadii, sagaal kulan oo keliya ayaa laga dhaliyay 40 gool.
 Hase yeeshee, maalintii ugu goolasha badnayd waxay ahayd Arbacadii toddobaadkii hore, markaas oo la dhaliyay 46 gool. Taasi waa tiradii saddexaad ee ugu badnayd ee hal maalin laga dhaliyo taariikhda tartanka.
 Marka la isku daro kulamadii Talaadada iyo Arbacada ee toddobaadkii hore, waxaa la dhaliyay 78 gool. Taasi waxay wareegga labaad ka dhigtay wareeggii ugu goolasha badnaa ee abid laga diiwaangeliyo tartanka.
 Tiradaasi waxay sagaal gool ka badan tahay 69-kii gool ee la dhaliyay wareeggii koowaad ee xilli ciyaareedkan. 
 Waqtigaas, wareegga koowaad ayaa hore u noqday kii labaad ee ugu goolasha badnaa tan iyo markii la hirgeliyay nidaamka cusub ee heerka horyaalka xilli ciyaareedkii 2024-2025.

 3 Saacadood ka hor Mareykanka oo sheegay inuu baabi’iyay in ka badan 300,000 oo fiise muddo ka yar laba sano 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Trump Maamulka madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu baabi’iyay in ka badan 300,000 oo fiise ama dal-kugal ah tan iyo markii uu xilka madaxweynaha mar labaad la wareegay.
 Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii sheegtay in tirada fiisooyinka lala laabtay kor u dhaaftay 300,000, iyadoo dowladda federaalku ay sii waddo adkeynta tallaabooyinka ka dhanka ah dadka soo-galootiga ah.
 Tiradan ayaa muujinaysa in xawaaraha lagu baabi’inayo ama lagu diidayo fiisooyinka uu si weyn u kordhay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay.
 “Waxaan baabi’inay in ka badan 300,000 oo fiise, tiraduna weli way sii kordhaysaa. Farriintayada ku socota dadka haysta fiisooyinka waa mid cad: u hoggaansama shuruucdayada, haddii kale waxaad lumin doontaan xaqa aad ugu safri kartaan Mareykanka,” ayay Moora Namdar, oo ah ku-xigeenka wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Mareykanka u qaabilsan arrimaha qunsuliyadaha, ku qortay barta X.
 Waxay intaas ku dartay in ilaalinta dalka iyo shacabka Mareykanku ay weli tahay mudnaanta koowaad ee madaxweyne Trump iyo xoghayaha arrimaha dibadda Marco Rubio.
 Namdar ayaa sidoo kale boggeeda ku baahisay farriin ka timid Aqalka Cad, taas oo sheegaysa in maamulka Trump uu fiisooyinka u diidmo u siinayo si ka dhakhso badan maamul kasta oo hore oo dalka soo maray.
 Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Tommy Pigott, ayaa isna sheegay in dadka ajaanibta ah ee fiisooyinkooda la baabi’iyay ay ka mid yihiin kuwa ku kacay falal sharci-darro ah ama khatar ku ah amniga qaranka.
 “Uma dulqaadanayno ajaanibta dalka ku jooga fiisaha ee jebiya sharciga, sameeya khiyaano ama khatar geliya amnigeenna qaranka,” ayuu yiri.
 Tirokoob la shaaciyay horraantii bishii August ee sannadkii hore ayaa muujinayay in maamulka Trump uu baabi’iyay ama diidmo siiyay in ka badan 175,000 oo fiise tan iyo markii uu xilka la wareegay.
 Tirada cusub ayaa muujinaysa koror weyn oo ku yimid fiisooyinka la diiday muddo kooban gudaheed.
 Madaxweyne Trump ayaa sheegay in dadka aan haysan sharci ay Mareykanka ku joogaan dib loogu celinayo dalalkooda si loo xoojiyo amniga gudaha ee dalka.

 3 Saacadood ka hor Netanyahu oo Trump kala hadlay suurtagalnimada weerar cusub oo lagu qaado Iran 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil, Benjamin Netanyahu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, ayaa wada-hadal telefoon oo uu la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ku muujiyay in labada dal ay suurtagal tahay inay weerar cusub ku qaadaan Iran.
 Wada-hadalka oo muuqaalkiisa lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinayay Netanyahu oo Trump uga mahadcelinaya taageerada uu u muujiyay Israa’iil, xilli doorashada dalkaasi ay dhici doonto toddobaadka soo socda.
 Doorashada ayaa si weyn loogu arkaa afti lagu qiimeynayo hoggaaminta Netanyahu, ka hor iyo kaddib weerarkii Xamaas ee bishii Oktoobar, iyo sida uu u maareeyay dagaalladii kala duwanaa ee dhacay, oo uu ku jiro dagaalka Iran. Waxaa la filayaa inuu wajahayo tartan adag.
 “Donald, waxaa jira hawl ina hor taalla. Sida aad sheegtay, waan wada qaban doonnaa. Waan dhammaystiri doonnaa, cid kalena ma qaban karto,” ayuu Netanyahu ku yiri Trump.
 Trump ayaa hore u sheegay inuusan weerar cusub ku qaadi doonin Iran ka hor doorashada xilliga dhexe ee Mareykanka.
 Hase yeeshee, warbaahinta Mareykanka ee Axios ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegtay in labada hoggaamiye ay ka wada hadleen suurtagalnimada in dib loo bilaabo weerarrada.
 Axios oo soo xiganaysay saddex ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegtay in wada-hadalladaasi ay dhaceen ka hor inta uusan Trump ku dhawaaqin inuusan Iran weerari doonin ka hor doorashada xilliga dhexe.
 Mas’uul ka tirsan Aqalka Cad ayaa wararka sheegaya in labada hoggaamiye ay ka wada hadleen dib u bilaabista dagaalka ku tilmaamay “kuwo been ah”, isaga oo daliishaday hadalka Trump ee ah inuusan weerar qaadi doonin ka hor doorashada bisha Nofeembar.
 Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegay in ciidamada milatari ee labada dal ay heegan sare ku jiraan, isla markaana ay dhammaystirayaan diyaargarowgooda haddii Trump uu beddelo mowqifkiisa.

 3 Saacadood ka hor Abiy Axmed oo digniin adag u diray Eritrea 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Office of the Prime Minister/Ethiopia 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Abiy Ahmed Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa sheegay in Itoobiya ay doonayso nabad ay la yeelato Eritrea, isla markaana ay rabto inay noqoto lamaane dhanka horumarka ah; hase yeeshee, wuxuu xusay in Eritrea "ay la kulmi doonto cawaaqib xun haddii ay sii waddo ku tiirsanaanta ciidamo kale, oo ay ku sii socoto waddadeeda burburka ah."

 4 Saacadood ka hor Trump oo sheegay in Ilhaan Cumar ay “xabsi geli karto”, 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Ilhan iyo Trump Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa sheegay in Ilhaan Cumar, oo ka tirsan xisbiga Dimuqraadiga isla markaana si weyn u dhaliisha, ay “xabsi geli karto”,.
 Hadalka madaxwaynaha ayaa imanaya xilli ay baaritaan lagu hayo dukumentiyadeeda socdaalka ee Mareykanka.
 Bartamihii bishan ayay ahayd markii mas'uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Mareykankaay baaritaan ku sameeyeen guriga xildhibaanadda matasha gobolka Minnesota Ilhan Cumar, taasoo qayb ka ah waxa lagu tilmaamay "baaritaan dambiyeed heer federaal ah".
 Waaxda Caddaaladda ayaa sheegtay in maxkamad ay ansixisay amarka lagu galay guriga. Nooca dambiga la baarayo weli si cad looma oga.
 Ka dib markii gurigeeda la baaray, Ilhaan ayaa barta X (Twitter-kii hore) ku soo qortay: "Waan fiicanahay. Ha isku khaldina arrintan: waa isku day lagu beegsanayo cadowga siyaasadeed, iyadoo la adeegsanayo awoodda sharci fulinta ee federaalka".

 4 Saacadood ka hor Iran oo sheegtay inaysan Mareykanka la hadli doonin ilaa laga fuliyo shuruudaheeda 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Madaxweynaha Iiraan Masoud Pezizkian oo Tehran kula kulmay Field Marshal Asim Mounir Iran ayaa taliyaha ciidamada Pakistan u sheegtay inaysan wada-hadallo la geli doonin Mareykanka ilaa laga fuliyo shuruudaha ay dejisay.
 Warbaahinta Iran ayaa sheegtay in madaxweynaha dalkaas, Masoud Pezeshkian, uu magaalada Tehran kula kulmay taliyaha ciidamada Pakistan, Field Marshal Asim Munir, ayna ka wada hadleen dadaallada socda ee wada-xaajoodka iyo xaaladaha gobolka.
 Pakistan ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraysa dhexdhexaadinta u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iran.
 Dadaallo hore oo lagu doonayay in lagu gaaro heshiis nabadeed ayaa horseeday is-afgarad hordhac ah bishii Juun ee sannadkii hore, balse heshiiskaasi wuxuu burburay toddobaadyo kaddib markii ay mar kale xoogaysteen xiisadaha u dhexeeya labada dal.
 Munir ayaa sidoo kale kulan la yeeshay guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka Iran, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf.
 Bayaan ay Iran soo saartay oo ku saabsan kulanka ayaa lagu sheegay in Tehran aysan dib u heli doonin kalsoonida Washington ilaa Mareykanku fuliyo toddobada shuruudood ee Iran ay bishii hore u dejisay dib u furista marin-biyoodka Hormuz.
 Shuruudahaas waxaa ka mid ah in Mareykanku qaado xayiraadaha saaran dekedaha Iran, uu joojiyo cunaqabateynta dhoofinta shidaalka Iran, isla markaana la soo afjaro colaadaha ka socda dhammaan jihooyinka gobolka.
 Madaxa sirdoonka Iran, Mohsen Rezaei, ayaa farriin la mid ah u gudbiyay Munir intii uu la hadlayay.
 Warbaahinta Iran ayaa sheegtay in Tehran aysan wada-hadallo la geli doonin Washington ilaa laga fuliyo dalabaadkeeda.
 Rezaei ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dhammaan uranium-ka la kobciyay uu ku sii nagaan doono gudaha Iran. Hadalkiisa ayaa la jaanqaadaya mowqifka hoggaamiyaha sare ee Iran, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, oo sheegay in uranium-ka la gaarsiiyay heer lagu samayn karo hub aan loo wareejin doonin dal kale.

 5 Saacadood ka hor Isbahaysiga Sacuudiga oo sheegay in la soo riday shan diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn 
 Isbahaysiga milatari ee uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudiga, ee dagaalka kula jira Xuutiyiinta Yemen, ayaa sheegay inuu qabtay oo burburiyay shan diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, kuwaas oo ku soo wajahnaa dhulka Sacuudiga.
 Mid ka mid ah meelaha la sheegay in diyaaradahaasi bartilmaameedsanayeen ayaa ah gobolka Madiina.
 Madiina, oo ay ku yaallaan Masjidka Nabiga iyo qabriga Nebi Muxammad, waa mid ka mid ah magaalooyinka ugu barakaysan Islaamka, waxaana kaalintaas la wadaagta magaalada Maka. Xuutiyiinta ayaa hore u ballanqaaday inaysan weerari doonin labada magaalo.
 Afhayeenka isbahaysiga, Turki al-Maliki, ayaa farriin uu ku baahiyay barta X ku sheegay in afar diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, kuwaas oo ku soo wajahnaa Sacuudiga, la qabtay lana burburiyay.
 Farriin kale ayuu ku sheegay in diyaaradahaasi lagu qabtay gobolka bariga Sacuudiga iyo gobolka Madiina.
 Al-Maliki oo aan sheegin cidda ka dambaysay weerarrada ayaa markii dambe xaqiijiyay in diyaarad kale oo aan duuliye lahayn lagu qabtay gobolka bariga Sacuudiga.
 Toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, Sacuudiga waxaa si joogto ah u bartilmaameedsanayay Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iran.
 Weerarradaas waxaa ka mid ahaa weerar lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Riyaad, kaas oo lagu tilmaamay weerarkii ugu dhimashada badnaa ee Sacuudiga ku dhaca sannadihii u dambeeyay.

 5 Saacadood ka hor Turkiga oo baarlamaanka u gudbiyay heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Makka 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Heshiiska saddex geesoodka Dowladda Turkiga ayaa guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka dalkaas u gudbisay hindise sharciyeed la xiriira heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Maka, kaas oo ay Turkiga, Pakistan iyo Sacuudiga kala saxiixdeen.
 Hindise-sharciyeedka ayaa marka hore loo gudbin doonaa guddiga arrimaha dibadda ee baarlamaanka Turkiga.
 Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, ra’iisul wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif, iyo dhaxal-sugaha boqortooyada Sacuudiga, Maxamed Bin Salmaan, ayaa heshiiska saxiixay 7-dii August.
 Dastuurka Turkiga ayaa dhigaya in heshiisyada caalamiga ah laga ansixiyo baarlamaanka dalkaas ka hor inta aysan dhaqan gelin.
 Turkiga ayaa hadda dib u eegaya baaxadda iyo qaab-dhismeedka sharci ee taageerada milatari ee uu siin karo dowladda Sacuudiga, taas oo ku salaysan heshiiskan.
 Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Turkiga, Hakan Fidan, ayaa isagoo ka hadlayay baaxadda heshiiska sheegay in Turkigu uusan ciidamadiisa u diri doonin gudaha dal kale si ay halkaas uga hawlgalaan, isla markaana uusan weerarro ka fulin doonin dhulka dal kale.
 Sacuudiga ayaa muddooyinkii dambe wajahayay weerarro sii kordhaya oo ay Xuutiyiintu ka fulinayaan Yemen.
 Turkiga ayaa ka fiirsanaya suurtagalnimada inuu Sacuudiga siiyo taageero milatari, isaga oo ku salaynaya heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Maka.

 7 Saacadood ka hor Trump: Waa inaan go’aamiyaa sida aan Iran uga adkaan lahayn, si kasta oo ay xaaladdu u adkaato 
 Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters 
 Qoraalka sawirka, Trump Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa sheegay inuusan u baahnayn wax caawimaad ah si uu Iran uga adkaado.
 Trump ayaa mar kale ku celiyay sheegashadiisa ah in Mareykanku uu si weyn uga gacan sarreeyo Iran dagaalka u dhexeeya labada dal.
 “Sidii aad la socotaan, si wanaagsan ayaan u wadnaa dagaalka Iran. Waxa keliya ee ay tahay inaan go’aamiyo waa sida aan guusha ku gaari doonno; ma waxaan rabnaa inaan si wanaagsan u guuleysanno mise si adag oo aan naxariis lahayn?” ayuu Trump ka sheegay shir jaraa’id oo Talaadadii fiidkii ka dhacay Aqalka Cad.
 “Si kastaba ha ahaatee, si wanaagsan ayaan u soconnaa, mana u baahnin cid naga caawisa,” ayuu raaciyay.
 Isagoo ka hadlayay sare u kaca qiimaha shidaalka ee ka dhashay xayiraadaha saameeyay isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodka Hormuz, ayuu Trump yiri dadka ayaa ka cabanaya qiimaha shidaalka oo sare u kacay.
 “Ma doonayo inaan hadal aan macno badan lahayn ku dhawaaqo, balse dhab ahaantii waa qiimo yar oo la bixinayo si looga hortago in Iran ay hesho hub nukliyeer ah,” ayuu yiri.
 Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu la xiriiray hoggaamiyeyaasha dalal dhowr ah si uu u ogaado kuwa diyaar u ah inay Mareykanka ka caawiyaan dagaalka.
 Wuxuu sheegay in hoggaamiyeyaasha uu la xiriiray ay u sheegeen inaysan diyaar u ahayn inay caawiyaan.
 “Waxaan tijaabinayay. Waxaan wacay madaxweynayaal iyo ra’iisul wasaareyaal kala duwan, waxaanan weydiiyay inay doonayaan inay na caawiyaan, waxayna igu yiraahdeen maya,” ayuu yiri Trump.
 Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Trump ma uusan sheegin magacyada hoggaamiyeyaasha uu la xiriiray ama faahfaahinta wada-hadallada uu la yeeshay.
 Hadalka Trump ayaa yimid saacado kaddib markii ra’iisul wasaaraha Israa’iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, uu baahiyay muuqaal laga duubay wada-hadal taleefoon oo uu la yeeshay Trump.

 Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iraan ayaa Al-Ikhbariya u sheegay in Tehran iyo Muscat ay heshiis ka gaareen maraakiibta isaga kala gudbaysa Marinka Hormuz.
 “Waxaa la diyaariyay khariidad gaar ah oo muujinaysa waddooyinkan, waxaana la go’aamiyay lana calaamadeeyay isku-duwayaasha juqraafiyeed ee marinnadaas.  Mohsen Rezaei, xoghayaha Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa kulan uu la yeeshay Asim Munir, taliyaha guud ee ciidamada qalabka sida ee Pakistan, ku sheegay: “In aysan ogolaan doonaa in hal qurub oo ka mid ah walxaha nukliyeerka ee la kobciyay laga saaro Iiraan”.
 Rezaei ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in aanay jiri doonin wax wadaxaajood ah ilaa Mareykanku dhiso kalsooni ama wax la isku halleyn karo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in tallaabada ugu horreysa ee kalsoonida lagu dhisi karo ay tahay in la fuliyo shuruudaha Iraan.
